| [Maturity assessment](SKILL.md) | Agent Skill | Assess how mature and how complex one machine, system or application is along the 16 IT/OT focus areas (identity, communication, protocols, data collection, storage, processing, analytics, control, information model, point of use), derive the complexity drivers behind the profile and the prerequisite chain between the areas, and turn the result into a route signal for the tool decision, the standard-system pick, the data check and the connector design. Rates qualitatively with an evidence grade, never from the top of the scale. Use when a machine, system or app must be judged before a route is chosen, when "can this be connected / is this app fit to integrate" is unclear, or when a use case or tool request needs an as-is profile of the thing it depends on. |
